items.label: two stages count and size three peaks
items.verdict: two stages work: joint sizes the three peaks and every gate passes

items.label: random six-component profile
items.verdict: the random profile is not recovered to the absolute gate; the numbers are reported as they are

items.label: representation error is not a range artefact
items.verdict: the floor is not a range artefact: the truth stays inside the measured u-range and the law still misrepresents it, so the composition problem is real

items.label: representation error is not look-up resolution
items.verdict: neither prediction holds: interpolation resolution does not explain the floor, so the per-station assumption itself has to be re-measured

items.label: contact half-width is not the missing coordinate
items.verdict: the width does not explain the spread of the residual: removing it changes the held-out floor by less than 30 %, so the missing physics is not the contact width and the per-station assumption itself has to be re-derived from the contact layer

items.label: per-station point Hertz
items.verdict: a per-station two-body Hertz model with no fitted stiffness still misses the floor, so the residual is not the two-body split either

items.label: vertical dynamics ruled out
items.verdict: the residual is static: its energy sits below 20 Hz and the peak lag is within a few mm, so the quasi-static family is right and the next candidate stays a per-station contact model

items.label: strip integral over combined gap and curvature
items.verdict: the strip integral still fails the un-bumped run, so the combined wheel-rail gap does not carry the split either: the contact layer has to come from the solver, not from a closed-form strip model

items.label: seated split equals rolling split
items.verdict: the static split tracks the rolling split (9/10 probes within 0.02, median 0.0022, worst 0.0218): usable as a forward, with the residual bias carried in the error budget

items.label: seated slope equals rolling slope
items.verdict: the seated slope is not the rolling slope: a seating table has the right zeros and the wrong derivative

items.label: inversion carries across the head
items.verdict: the inversion carries across the head

items.label: two passes join into one band surface
items.verdict: the two passes join into one single-valued band surface
